back.gloss: Kahulugan: If a care instruction changes after the doctor's round, I make sure the patient is told about the change before they notice it themselves.

options.text: Kahulugan: When the care goal is unclear, I do not continue routinely but ask the team for a shared decision before guiding the patient.
Kahulugan: When a patient needs emotional support, I do not offer ready-made explanations but ask what is burdening them most right now.
Kahulugan: If a patient needs help dressing, I support their independence while making sure the assistance does not cause pain or shame.
Kahulugan: If a care instruction changes after the doctor's round, I make sure the patient is told about the change before they notice it themselves.
